title: Pure Darkness
description: This makes the ENTIRE world dark This can be fun for challenges!
body:
This texture pack makes your entire world(Besides the sky) completely dark like your in a cave constantly.
This texture pack is mainly made just for challanges, You can use it for PvP, Survival, Creative, Anything IDRC.
Have fun:)
# WARNING!
**This mod makes EVERYTHING EXCEPT THE SKY DARK, This includes inventory, Menu, and EVERYTHING ELSE.**
